plaintextJournal.content:
;; -*- mode: org; mode: beancount; -*-

option "title" "Rustledger shadow corpus - Journal Export"

option "operating_currency" "USD"

option "name_assets" "Actifs"
option "name_liabilities" "Dettes"
option "name_equity" "Capital"
option "name_income" "Revenus"
option "name_expenses" "Depenses"
plugin "beancount.plugins.auto_accounts"

2024-01-10 * "Market" "Buy stock"
  Actifs:Brokerage                                       10 HOOL {20 USD, 2024-01-10}
  Actifs:Cash                                          -200 USD

2024-01-20 * "Cafe" "Lunch" #food
  Depenses:Food                                       25.50 USD
  Actifs:Cash                                        -25.50 USD

2024-02-15 * "Employer" "Salary new" #work ^pay
  Actifs:Cash                                          1200 USD
  Revenus:Salary                                      -1200 USD

2024-03-01 * "Cafe" "Lunch again" #food
  Depenses:Food                                          30 USD
  Actifs:Cash                                           -30 USD
